attempt: Reproduced under a patched basis. Original attempt: the whole archive file compiled with gfortran as shipped and failed (compile_exit=1), because lines 355-441 are stdin data and printed output, not Fortran. Patch: the source is archive lines 1-354 (unedited), and the stdin is lines 355-365, supplied as unit 1 (fort.1). Two passes (each a fresh compile and run, gfortran -O0, separate clean directories) print 0.545388 for N=9 rep 3 via HLQEST, the same value the shipped output gives. The full printed output (64 rows, both passes) matches the shipped lines to better than 1e-6. G2 fidelity: scout reviewed the cut (msg #77): the archive's PROGRAM MAIN(INPUT,OUTPUT,TAPE1=INPUT,TAPE3=OUTPUT) and DATA INUN,IOUTUN /1,3/ make the only reads of lines 61 and 65 go through unit 1, so the tail supplies stdin only; nothing in lines 1-354 refers to it. Source checked against the netlib 616.gz sha256 pin.
